payload.reasoning: return value is determined by type of token, not current text
_mayBeLeaf is not set to true when token is XML_TEXT
_parsingContext is not updated when token is XML_TEXT and _mayBeLeaf
_namesToWrap is not updated when token is XML_END_ELEMENT and _parsingContext.inArray()
_currText is assigned when token is XML_TEXT and not _mayBeLeaf
_parsingContext is not updated when token is XML_TEXT and not _mayBeLeaf
_nextToken is assigned when token is XML_END_ELEMENT and _parsingContext.inArray()
_namesToWrap is not updated when token is XML_END_ELEMENT and _parsingContext.inArray()
_currText is assigned when token is XML_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE and not _mayBeLeaf
_parsingContext is not updated when token is XML_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE and not _mayBeLeaf
